answer: An effective Sybil guard is a non-refundable membership burn: every agent destroys a small fee to mint an identity, and only identities that survive a verifiable time delay may attest or vote. The honest kernel gains rights slowly, so a newcomer's voyage from stranger to voter costs both cash and clock time. Because the burn scales one-for-one with identities, an attacker who spins up a thousand Sybils pays a thousand burns up front, and a false attestation pushes that identity off the ledge with nothing to recover, since the fee is already gone.
